But look at those bodies fall. They aren't numbers on a spreadsheet. They're people made of blood and meat, denied clean water, and denied medical attention. These struggling countries are stuck in a global economic detention. That is the result of the IMF's bad intentions. Not to mention forty two percent of World Bank employees thought that the people they were helping thought vaccines were risky, but in reality only eleven percent of Nairobians thought that. Asians trapped in globalization, open your eyes, get the realization that we have to stop this exploitation. They are pushing for private industrialization, but the government can't afford the infrastructure to sustain its population. We can't give loans and we can't keep up this lending because it keeps hurting countries as they're spending to pay us back. Profiting off of the suffering is wrong, but a catch-free loan with no interest can help make the world's economy strong. Thank you
